note: Set A covers the sheet's core millwork dimensions and materials with mostly correct bindings (North Island 6'-7 1/2" overall and 3'-3 3/4" segments, MWK04/MWK05 widths, laundry 2'-5 1/16", bulkhead P3 finish, 1" side clearance), while Set B omits these key dimensions and instead pads with title-block/revision trivia. Both sets contain misbindings: A mislabels the 2'-2 3/16" and 3'-3 3/4" dims as 'sink section'/'DW section', rounds 8'-4" to '8 ft', and invents a 'MWK04 offset from dining table 6"'; B invents 'SK = skirt', calls 8'-4" a millwork section width, binds 6" to a dining-table clearance, treats QZ as a component of MWK04, and names the project BOREALIS although the title block gives TEAM ALBERTA. A's errors are largely labeling/rounding on otherwise real dimensions, whereas B's misbindings attach values to the wrong elements and it misses the main elevation dimensions, so A is the better set overall.
